# Fulmine-Sparks - Lightning-Paid AI Image Generation

## Overview
Fulmine-Sparks is a serverless API for generating high-quality AI images using Bitcoin Lightning Network payments. It uses the SeeDream 4.5 model for state-of-the-art image generation.

## Permitted Uses
- ✅ Generate images for personal use
- ✅ Generate images for commercial use
- ✅ Integrate into applications and bots
- ✅ Use in research and development
- ✅ Educational purposes
- ✅ Redistribute generated images (with optional attribution)

## Prohibited Uses
- ❌ Illegal content generation
- ❌ Hateful or discriminatory content
- ❌ Sexual or adult content
- ❌ Deceptive or fraudulent use
- ❌ Intellectual property violations
- ❌ Harassment or abuse
- ❌ Reverse engineering the service
- ❌ Service circumvention or rate limit bypassing

## Rate Limits
- **Recommended:** 1 request per 20 seconds
- **Maximum:** 10 requests per minute
- **Burst limit:** 5 concurrent requests
- **Enforcement:** 3 unpaid invoices → temporarily blocked (pay one to unblock)
- **Tracking:** Per IP address via DynamoDB

## Pricing
- **Cost:** $0.05 USD per image
- **Currency:** Bitcoin Lightning Network
- **Payment:** BOLT11 invoices (standard Lightning payment format)
- **Invoice expiration:** 1 hour
- **Refunds:** No refunds - all payments are final and irreversible

## Attribution
- Attribution appreciated but not required
- If attributing: "Image generated by Fulmine-Sparks"
- No license restrictions on generated images

## API Documentation

### Generate Image
```
POST https://c2f4z5jyqj.execute-api.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/prod/api/v1/services/image/generate

Content-Type: application/json

{
  "prompt": "A beautiful sunset over mountains",
  "model": "seedream-4.5",
  "num_outputs": 1
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "status": "payment_required",
  "invoice": {
    "payment_hash": "abc123def456...",
    "payment_request": "lnbc500n...",
    "amount_sats": 77,
    "price_usd": 0.05
  }
}
```

### Check Image Status
```
GET https://c2f4z5jyqj.execute-api.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/prod/api/v1/services/image/status/{payment_hash}
```

### Retrieve Image
```
GET https://c2f4z5jyqj.execute-api.us-east-2.amazonaws.com/prod/api/v1/services/image/retrieve/{payment_hash}
```

## Payment Terms
- **Price:** $0.05 USD per image (77 sats at current BTC price)
- **Payment method:** Bitcoin Lightning Network only
- **Payment finality:** Irreversible - no refunds
- **Image delivery:** Immediate upon payment detection
- **Invoice expiration:** 1 hour

## Refund Policy
- **NO REFUNDS** - All payments are final
- Images are digital goods delivered immediately
- No refunds for any reason
- Service provided "as is"

## Data & Privacy
- **Prompts:** NOT stored
- **Generated images:** Cached for 1 minute only (for payment confirmation)
- **Payment info:** Handled by Alby Wallet (read Alby privacy policy)
- **User tracking:** Minimal (IP-based rate limiting only)
- **Logs:** Retained for 30 days

## GDPR & Privacy Compliance
- **GDPR:** Compliant (EU users)
- **CCPA:** Compliant (California users)
- **User rights:** Access, deletion, data portability
- **Data retention:** Minimal and automatic via TTL

## Acceptable Use Policy

### Prohibited Content
- Illegal content
- Hateful or discriminatory content
- Sexual or adult content
- Deceptive or fraudulent content
- Intellectual property violations
- Privacy violations
- Harassment or abuse

### Prohibited Activities
- Service abuse (rate limit circumvention)
- Reverse engineering
- Unauthorized access attempts
- Resale of the service itself (generated images are fine to resell)

### Enforcement
- **First violation:** Warning
- **Repeated violations:** Suspension (7-30 days)
- **Severe violations:** Permanent termination
- **Legal action:** May be pursued for serious violations

## API Compliance
- **Health Check:** `GET /health` returns 200 OK
- **Rate Limit Response:** 429 status code with clear error message
- **Error Messages:** Descriptive and actionable
- **Response format:** Standard JSON

## Reliability
- **SLA:** Best-effort (not guaranteed)
- **Uptime:** Typically 99%+
- **Image generation:** 30-60 seconds typical
- **Payment confirmation:** <1 second
